scope: Disposable parser integration specimen; no production adapter, RA implementation, SQL execution or PostgreSQL semantic proof

toolchain.initial_environment: lean/lake were Elan shims with no installed toolchain; local dependency had no .lake artifacts; WSL had no installed distribution
toolchain.resolution: Downloaded and verified an isolated portable release under this probe's .tools directory; no global Elan or PATH configuration changed

commands.interpretation: No matching prohibited source tokens; rg exit 1 means no matches
Smoke succeeded with no Lean or Elan directory on PATH; not a clean-machine portability test

native_probe.implemented: Typed tagged JSON export for a deliberately restricted subset of SELECT, VALUES, set operations and UPDATE
native_probe.integer_encoding: Unsigned literal magnitude is a decimal string; negative sign is a separate unary AST node
native_probe.null_encoding: SQL NULL has tag sql_null; absent optional syntax is JSON null

observed_results.sample_rule: First five statements each from fixtures/crud/select.sql, insert.sql, update.sql, delete.sql; first three records each from external_postgresql/river.jsonl and temporal.jsonl
observed_results.determinism_claim: Byte-identical outputs on the two observed executions per specimen only; no universal or cross-platform determinism theorem
observed_results.roundtrip_claim: Parsed canonical SQL yielded equal SQLean ASTs for the tested accepted specimens; this is finite syntax evidence, not execution equivalence

breaking_modes_observed.outcome: Parsed and exported with syntax-only assurance
Parsed but unsupported by specimen export; no purity claim

breaking_modes_observed.witness: UPDATE FROM, window function, DML CTE, FK DDL, schema-qualified UPDATE target
JOIN, ORDER BY/LIMIT and function calls
breaking_modes_observed.outcome: Parsed but explicitly unsupported; none silently lowered

logical_trust.interpretation: Standard Lean foundations only for audited declarations; these programs are not a theorem of SQL semantics or native execution correctness
runtime_tcb: Lean compiler/runtime and native toolchain for executable behavior
logical_trust.upstream_boundary: Full PostgreSQL grammar CST, advanced typed AST, independent SELECT validity and serialization contracts remain distinct; this probe invokes typed parsing/rendering only

protocol_limits: One SQL argument per process is a specimen interface, not production IPC; command lines may be logged and have OS length limits
The PowerShell runner uses argument-list transport without shell interpolation and a 30-second process timeout, but this is not server resource isolation
No version negotiation, input byte cap, cancellation protocol, comprehensive source mapping, binder agreement, complete AST inventory or JSON inverse exists
A successful process exit means a report was emitted; clients must inspect parse_status and export_status
Canonical rendering is upstream unchecked rendering; the observed AST comparison does not turn it into an independent rendering certificate
Native binary size is 111025664 bytes; release size and dependency packaging need measurement before distribution

licensing.parser_root_license: No root LICENSE/COPYING found at pinned checkout; redistribution permission remains an open release gate
licensing.source_fixture_handling: Corpus evidence records exact SQL SHA256 and original provenance; it does not copy the upstream SQL source text
licensing.toolchain_attribution: Portable release retains its bundled license files; release asset provenance and SHA256 are recorded above

recommendation.transaction_input: Use a structured envelope of separately parsed statements with explicit parameter scope and no-concurrency assumption in the first model
